name: Euphrenic Player Lite for YouTube
author: Heath Woodward

sections.description:
Probably the best YouTube video player for WordPress. Display YouTube videos in a beautiful gallery grid with an elegant player overlay. This lightweight, user-friendly plugin creates responsive video galleries that load quickly and engage your visitors.

No coding required, simply paste YouTube URLs, customise the appearance, and the plugin takes care of everything else. Perfect for showcasing video tutorials, testimonials, product demonstrations, or any YouTube content on your WordPress site.

Features include customisable thumbnail sizes, flexible gallery layouts, responsive design for all devices, and a sleek video player overlay that keeps visitors on your page. The intuitive drag-and-drop interface makes organising your videos effortless.

Enhance your site with professional-looking video galleries in minutes with Euphrenic Player Lite.

Upgrade to Pro for extra features, including unlimited galleries, extra thumbnail layouts and a choice of front-end players. Pay only once, no subscription.

Features

  • Simply paste the YouTube URLs
  • No API required
  • Paste URLs from any YouTube channel
  • Generate shortcodes to embed the galleries on any page or post
  • Choice of thumbnail layouts

Pro Features

Take your music sharing to the next level with Euphrenic Player PRO:

  • Create unlimited galleries
  • More thumbnail gallery choices
  • Additional players
  • Priority support
  • Pay only once, no subscriptions
  • Updates for life

Learn more about Euphrenic Player PRO
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/euphrenic-player-lite-for-youtube directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Euphrenic Player in the admin menu to add any YouTube URLs.
sections.faq:
How many YouTube galleries can I have?

Euphrenic Player Lite for YouTube allows you to create two galleries. For unlimited galleries, you need to upgrade to the PRO version.

Can I customise the player’s appearance?

The Lite version includes a standard player. For additional colours and themes, you need the Pro version.

Is there a limit on the number of videos per gallery?

The plugin allows you to add up to 15 URLs per gallery. This is for better management. However, you can stack two shortcodes to display more thumbnails.

Is it mobile responsive?

Of course, it’s 2025. 😎

Do I need a YouTube API key?

No, Euphrenic Player Lite does not require a YouTube API key. It works with standard YouTube URLs.
